Module com.example.miniproyecto_batalla_naval
Package com.example.miniproyecto_batalla_naval.persistence

Class PlayerFileManager

java.lang.Object
com.example.miniproyecto_batalla_naval.persistence.PlayerFileManager
public class PlayerFileManager extends Object
Manages the storage and retrieval of player information. This class saves basic player statistics in a plain text file using a simple key-value format. It is mainly used to persist information that can be easily read or modified without relying on object serialization. Each line of the file follows the format: 
 key=value

  • Method Details

    • save

      public void save(String nickname, int shipsSunkByHuman, int shipsSunkByMachine)
      Saves the player's information into the text file. If the destination directory does not exist, it is created automatically. Existing data is overwritten with the new values.
      Parameters:
      nickname - the player's nickname
      shipsSunkByHuman - the number of ships sunk by the human player
      shipsSunkByMachine - the number of ships sunk by the machine
      Throws:
      RuntimeException - if an error occurs while writing the player file

    • load

      public Map<String,String> load()
      Loads the player information stored in the text file. Each line is interpreted as a key-value pair separated by the '=' character. If the file does not exist, an empty map is returned.
      Returns:
      a map containing all loaded player information, or an empty map if no file exists
      Throws:
      RuntimeException - if an error occurs while reading the player file
